title: 74B model ab 24GB mein - local AI agent
content:
[HOOK: face to camera]
74 BILLION parameter ka model...
sirf 24GB memory mein.

[SCREEN: blogs.nvidia.com - Nemotron 3.5 Bolt | Oct 15, 2026]
NVIDIA ne launch kiya hai Nemotron 3.5 Bolt.
Made for local AI agents.

[GRAPHIC: 74B total | 9B active | 2-bit | fits in 24GB | Source: blogs.nvidia.com]
74B total parameters...
par ek time pe sirf 9 BILLION active.
2-bit compression se ye 24GB mein fit hota hai.

[SCREEN: NVIDIA's own Nemotron visuals | Source: blogs.nvidia.com]
For teams with an NVIDIA GPU... ye Ollama pe available hai.
Web research, writing, code debugging...
sab apni machine pe. CLOUD pe kuch nahi jaata.

[CAM: close-up]
Ab ek honest baat.
Ollama ke page pe likha hai...
Apple Silicon abhi SUPPORTED nahi hai.
You need an NVIDIA GPU machine for this one.

[CAM: face]
Business ke liye ye bada hai.
Client ka data bahar nahi jaana chahiye?
Private local agent... ab possible hai.

[CTA]
DM me 'AI' if you want this for your business.
